title: Move house
tagline: Deposit, notice, insurance, energy and your new address sorted in one go.
trigger: A rent deposit, a removal company, or a month with rent to two different landlords.

steps.title: Rent deposit without emptying your savings
steps.description: A KBC rental guarantee instead of two or three months' rent blocked on an account.
steps.why: Based on the rent you pay. Your landlord only receives the guarantee, not your finances.
steps.result: Rental guarantee issued; the certificate is in your digital vault.

steps.title: Give notice to your current landlord
steps.description: Your notice by registered e-mail, with proof of sending and delivery, instead of a trip to the post office.
steps.why: IPEX only receives your name and e-mail address.

win.customer: Legal proof of notice in two minutes

steps.result: Notice sent by registered e-mail. Proof of delivery is in your digital vault.

steps.title: Insure your new home
steps.description: Tenant's or home insurance for the new address, starting on the day you get the keys.
steps.why: Most rental contracts require it from day one.
steps.result: Home insurance moved to your new address.

steps.title: Energy at the new address
steps.description: Join KBC's group purchase of electricity and gas, with your meter readings on moving day.
steps.why: A move is the easiest moment to switch supplier.
steps.result: Registered for the group purchase; your meter readings reminder is set for moving day.

steps.title: Getting around from your new address
steps.description: Shared cars or bikes near your new home, so you only own a car if you really need one.
steps.why: Cambio only receives your name, e-mail, region and commute.

win.customer: Mobility that fits the new neighbourhood

steps.result: Shared mobility account ready near your new address.

steps.title: Your new address everywhere
steps.description: Your address updated at KBC, with a checklist for the municipality, eBox and your contracts.
steps.why: We already know which insurers and suppliers you pay; we list them for you.
steps.result: Address updated at KBC; a checklist of the contracts to update is in your digital vault.
